# Native DSP config schema

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-dsp-schema.py from app/src/main/schema/native_bmw_dsp.schema. Do not edit by hand. -->

The flat `float[309]` Kotlin sends to `configureNativeBmwDsp()` and `NativeBmwDspProcessor::configure()` reads. Generated from `app/src/main/schema/native_bmw_dsp.schema`, like the C++ header (`NativeBmwDspSchema.h`), the Kotlin indices and defaults (`NativeBmwDspSchema.kt`) and `native-tests/default_config.txt`. To change the layout, edit the schema and run `scripts/gen-dsp-schema.py`; CI fails if a generated file is out of date.

Slots are append-only: a retired slot is never reused for a different meaning without a migration, and nothing after it ever moves, because saved tunings are stored by index.

**Reader**: *native* = `configure()` reads and validates it (a non-finite value rejects the whole update; native-tests checks this for every slot); *Kotlin only* = native never reads it (migration markers, UI state, legacy values Kotlin migrates from); *reserved* = nothing reads it.

226 native, 80 Kotlin only, 3 reserved.
